rules.text: Refunds under $50: approve without asking. Over $50: bring it to the throne.
Launch emails: under 100 words, no emojis, Bill signs off.
UI changes need screenshots in both light and dark themes.
Post every release stage and failure to #releases.
Any single events cost over $500 goes to Bill first.

automations.name: Monthly close
automations.task: Run the monthly close for last month: reconcile Stripe payouts with the bank export on payout ID, categorize expenses, and present the P&L (revenue, gross margin, burn, runway) for Bill to approve.

automations.name: Support digest
automations.task: Summarize last week's support tickets: volume, top 3 themes with counts, refunds approved under $50, and anything waiting on the throne.

automations.name: Payout failed
automations.task: A Stripe payout failed. Draft a short reply asking the creator for updated bank details, do not retry the payout, and tell Finance it is pending.

automations.name: Flaky test sweep
automations.task: Find tests in parrot that failed then passed on rerun in the last 24h. File one Linear ticket per flaky test with the failing log excerpt.

automations.name: New review under 3 stars
automations.task: A new App Store review under 3 stars arrived. Match it to a feedback cluster, draft a reply that names the fix without arguing, and link the Linear ticket if it is a bug.
